label: David L. Norquist
narrative: David L. Norquist signed the message from the Under Secretary of Defense (Comptroller) and Chief Financial Officer in the Department of Defense Agency Financial Report for fiscal year 2018, the report accompanying the first full-scope financial statement audit the Department had ever undergone. His words in that message are the founding document of the modern audit record: 'In FY 2018, the Department underwent its first full-scope financial statement audit. As anticipated, our independent auditor, the Department of Defense Office of Inspector General, issued a Disclaimer of Opinion as the result of the audit.' Norquist subsequently became Deputy Secretary of Defense - the office which, under DoD Directive 5205.07, holds authority, direction and control over the entire Department special access program enterprise through the DoD Special Access Program Central Office. That combination is unusual and worth recording plainly: the same official ran the Department's books at the moment they were first declared unauditable, and then held the office with complete visibility over the Department's compartmented programme portfolio. He has made no public statement connecting the two.

timeline.text: David L. Norquist, Under Secretary of Defense (Comptroller) and Chief Financial Officer, writes in the FY2018 Agency Financial Report: 'In FY 2018, the Department underwent its first full-scope financial statement audit. As anticipated, our independent auditor, the Department of Defense Office of Inspector General, issued a Disclaimer of Opinion as the result of the audit.' It will be the first of eight.
